name: Principal Curvature Direction Estimation
definition: A method to compute principal curvature directions in 3D scalar fields faster than extremal value quadratic forms, by computing an orthonormal basis for the gradient and solving for the angle theta.
summary: Principal Curvature Direction Estimation computes principal curvature angles in a 3D scalar field faster than extremal value quadratic forms by solving for an angle in a local orthonormal basis.
